AZR_Entrance.text: PUBLIC ENTRANCE — World-class glass-and-water arrival plaza with families, influencers, sponsor signage, bright uniforms, and a huge SEA TURTLE THURSDAYS banner.

AZR_OpsRoom.text: BACKSTAGE OPS ROOM — Clean, technical, busy control space with readable monitors for water systems, guest counts, sponsor arrivals, weather, and animal-care schedules.

AZR_MediaPrep.text: PUBLIC MEDIA PREP ZONE — Ring lights, sponsor backdrop, turtle imagery, polished content-production setup adjacent to public space.

AZR_GlassCorridor.text: GLASS CORRIDOR — Transitional space between glossy public spectacle and backstage operations, with the park visibly gleaming beyond the glass.

AZR_GuestExperienceSuite.text: GUEST EXPERIENCE SUITE — Sleek sponsor-facing meeting area with polished slide decks, gift bags, institutional branding, and controlled executive presentation.

AZR_TurtleQueue.text: TURTLE PAVILION PUBLIC QUEUE — Beautiful guest-facing space with overproduced Sea Turtle Thursdays signage, families, kids, VIPs, sponsor wall, and clear sightlines toward the habitat.

AZR_ServiceCorridor.text: TURTLE PAVILION STAFF CORRIDOR — Clean staff-only path with labeled gear, carts, water-testing station, habitat windows, and protected access to the quiet-zone door.

AZR_FinfluencerStage.text: TURTLE PAVILION MINI-STAGE — Polished sponsor backdrop and media setup near the habitat; initially positioned too close to the quiet-zone staff door.

AZR_PublicViewing.text: TURTLE PAVILION PUBLIC VIEWING AREA — Refined guest space beside the habitat, capable of being reframed into calm, respectful viewing without reducing its premium feel.

AZR_BackstageHuddle.text: BACKSTAGE SERVICE CORRIDOR — Compact clean working corridor where the ensemble can huddle quickly without losing the visible sense of a busy park around them.

AZR_BreakArea.text: BACKSTAGE BREAK AREA — Clean employee decompression space with sea-turtle cupcakes after the event.

AZR_StaffOverlook.text: STAFF OVERLOOK / LOADING-DOCK EDGE — Quiet end-of-day staff area with a view of the gorgeous park glowing at sunset; public magic remains visible at a distance.

AZR_DolphinGallery.text: DOLPHIN GALLERY — Luminous, high-draw public habitat with sweeping blue glass, controlled keeper return points, clear guest barriers, premium sightlines, and enough public space for a calm trainer-led retrieval demonstration.

AZR_DolphinBackstage.text: DOLPHIN CARE BACKSTAGE — Clean professional animal-care and behavior workspace adjoining the habitat, with trainer stations, behavior logs, approved objects, locked storage, staff-only access, and no grimy industrial texture.

AZR_FoodCourt.text: AZURE REACH FOOD COURT — Bright, polished family dining area with digital menus, playful marine-themed food presentation, clean service counters, and sightlines toward public exhibits.

AZR_ServiceDock.text: QUIET SERVICE DOCK — Clean end-of-day working edge beside the dolphin habitat, with dimming stadium lights, water reflecting sunset, soft pump ambience, and distant public spectacle.
